build_HRFuseScales: build an HRFuseScales module to fuse multi-scale HRNet feature maps into a single representation
create_HRFuseScales_init: create an HRFuseScales instance with custom in_channels list and output channels for feature fusion
run_HRFuseScales_forward: run the forward pass of HRFuseScales with a tuple of multi-scale feature tensors
review_HRFuseScales_increase_layers: review the increase_layers ModuleList that upscales each resolution branch to 128, 256, 512, 1024 channels
refactor_HRFuseScales_downsample_layers: refactor the downsample_layers ConvModule chain that downsamples and fuses features across scales with residual addition
